name: armasu-copy-check
description: Check one piece of Armasu interface copy against the house writing rules and for whether the person reading it understands it where it shows

follows_rules.instructions: Does `text` obey every rule in `rules`? One broken rule means no.

clear.instructions: Would `reader`, seeing `text` at `where`, understand what happened or what is being asked, and what they can do next when there is something to do, without knowing how the app works inside?
